domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
k ranges over integers with 1 less than or equal to k and k less than or equal to n
the floor function is applied to real numbers (so it is always defined)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: Fix an integer n greater than 1. Define f(x) = floor of n times x minus the sum from k = 1 to n of (floor of k times x) divided by k. Determine the set of real numbers x for which f(x) is a global maximum among all real y, and determine the value of that global maximum.
quantifier_order: for a given integer n greater than 1
find real x such that for all real y, expression at x is at least the expression at y
and there exists at least one real x achieving that maximal value

variables.name: n
variables.role: fixed parameter for the maximization problem; assumes n is greater than 1

variables.name: x
variables.role: optimization variable over which the expression is maximized

variables.name: k
variables.role: summation index in the expression, ranging from 1 to n

witness_dependencies: the maximizer x (if it exists) may depend on the fixed parameter n
the maximal value may depend on the fixed parameter n

statement_nl: Fix an integer n greater than 1. Define f(x) = floor of n times x minus the sum from k = 1 to n of (floor of k times x) divided by k. Determine the set of real numbers x for which f(x) is a global maximum among all real y, and determine the value of that global maximum.
